methodology.head_to_head_score: explicit 1v1 pair; counts runtime metrics where either side has data; excludes metrics where neither side has data; tie handling follows suite head_to_head_tie_policy
methodology.overall_suite_score: all applicable runtime metric checks + all applicable catalog contract checks
methodology.lane_suite_scores: quick/dynamic/human suite scores use the same formula but only checks tagged to that mode
methodology.token_efficiency_score: token-aware blended score using effective tokens per success, token telemetry coverage, success quality, and cost probe reliability
